import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0032:
# Pose 32: pos = (0.0, 3.3), heading = 90.0 (facing +x)
# In front (+x) is sofa, floor lamp, potted plant 2!
# On the left (which would be +y / north) is chair 2 (partially visible on left: brown wood)
img32 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0032.png')

# 1. Floor lamp base:
# Lamp base is on the right: col ~ 420..490, y ~ 380..420
lamp_mask = (img32[:,:,0] > 70) & (img32[:,:,0] < 100) & (img32[:,:,1] > 70) & (img32[:,:,1] < 95) & (img32[:,:,2] > 70) & (img32[:,:,2] < 95)
ys, xs = np.where(lamp_mask & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 400))
print('Lamp base in obs 32 xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
d = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx = (center_x - cx) * d / f
# heading 90 deg: forward is +x, right is -y
# world_x = cam_x + d = 0.0 + d
# world_y = cam_y - dx = 3.3 - dx
lamp_x = 0.0 + d
lamp_y = 3.3 - dx
print(f'Lamp from obs 32: d={d:.3f}, dx={dx:.3f} -> x={lamp_x:.3f}, y={lamp_y:.3f}')

# 2. Plant 2 (in foreground of obs 32):
# Pot bottom:
pot_mask = (img32[:,:,2] > 140) & (img32[:,:,0] < 80) & (img32[:,:,1] < 100)
ys, xs = np.where(pot_mask & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 350))
print('Plant 2 in obs 32 pot ys:', ys.min(), ys.max(), 'xs:', xs.min(), xs.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2
d_plant = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx_plant = (center_x - cx) * d_plant / f
plant2_x = 0.0 + d_plant
plant2_y = 3.3 - dx_plant
print(f'Plant 2 from obs 32: d={d_plant:.3f}, dx={dx_plant:.3f} -> x={plant2_x:.3f}, y={plant2_y:.3f}')

# 3. Sofa in obs 32:
# Sofa base:
sofa_mask = (img32[:,:,0] > 100) & (img32[:,:,0] < 140) & (img32[:,:,1] > 100) & (img32[:,:,1] < 140) & (img32[:,:,2] > 100) & (img32[:,:,2] < 140)
ys, xs = np.where(sofa_mask & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 350))
print('Sofa in obs 32 ys:', ys.min(), ys.max(), 'xs:', xs.min(), xs.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2
d_sofa = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx_sofa = (center_x - cx) * d_sofa / f
sofa_x = 0.0 + d_sofa
sofa_y = 3.3 - dx_sofa
print(f'Sofa from obs 32: d={d_sofa:.3f}, dx={dx_sofa:.3f} -> x={sofa_x:.3f}, y={sofa_y:.3f}')
"
